interpretation: Required-bottom-sheet restricts primary reservation side. Contract-group bottom offers can retain top-primary reservations with physical components on both faces. The two input rejections are not infeasibility evidence and did not exercise placement.

Adding group rotations to granular-minor, vertical compaction and estimator-first did not resolve 162x150.5 under this search recipe. Different rejection subjects are not proof of quality improvement.
Initial two probes ran concurrently; timing is not a controlled speed comparison. Search-level receipt reconciliation applies only to the completed portfolio, not pre-search input errors.

Code inspection found contact-repaired single-group variants are appended to the offered catalogue after pair generation, but are not included in single_group for future disjoint group combinations. This is a search-coverage hypothesis, not yet a demonstrated defect or a reason to increase budgets.
